study: Round 5 addendum (T0, T5, T6, T7) — requested 2026-09-26 14:33 ET
note: T1-T4 were not specified to this executor; T6's 'T1 picks' leg is therefore not run. Same rules: free data only (historical SIP, Alpaca news), read-only, nice 15, <= 1 multi-symbol request/s (the S1 quote fetch is paused while these fetches run).
T0: inventory of external data sources by grepping the repo (no secrets read)

T5_news.universe: L = U2 (108 liquid names); days = edge2 split (tune 150 / validate 50 / holdout 50); 10-day forward returns truncate at 2026-09-25
T5_news.data: Alpaca historical news (Benzinga) via NewsClient, symbols = U2; SIP daily bars (close-to-close, volume)
T5_news.news_day: an item tagged with the symbol, created_at in (16:00 ET day d-1, 15:30 ET day d]
T5_news.event_E1: news_day AND |r_d| >= 2 x std of the prior 20 daily returns AND volume_d >= 1.5 x mean prior 20 daily volumes; direction = sign(r_d) (r_d = close_d / close_{d-1} - 1)
T5_news.event_E2_count_spike: count of items in that window >= max(3, 3 x mean daily count over the prior 20 days); direction = sign(r_d)
T5_news.control_E0: the same move+volume condition with NO news item (isolates the news part)
T5_news.entry_exit: enter at close_d, exit at close_{d+h}, h = 1, 5, 10 trading days; cost = one modeled full spread (U2 SpreadModel at 15:55)
T5_news.tested_side: follow the day's direction (long if r_d > 0, short if r_d < 0), reported per side; long side is the promotion candidate
T5_news.baseline: same-day equal-weight mean of all U2 names over the same horizon (excess return); and 5 random U2 names same day
T5_news.promotion: net excess > 0 on tune AND validate, day-clustered t >= 2 on tune+validate pooled; holdout printed once only for promoted cells

T6_breadth.measures: from U2 SIP daily closes: % of names above their 20-day and 50-day SMA, advance/decline ratio, SPY 20-day realized vol; all as of the PRIOR close (known before the open)
T6_breadth.rule_book: trade the round-4 L intraday book only on days where prior-close % of U2 above the 50-day SMA >= 50% AND SPY 20-day realized vol <= its trailing 250-day median
T6_breadth.applied_to: round-4 book specs limit 10bp:5:30 and market 30 on L (all 108 names); report tune / validate / holdout for filter-on days vs filter-off days vs all
T6_breadth.rule_T1: same rule on T1 picks — NOT RUN (T1 not specified to this executor)

T7_source_audit.nominations: first appearance per (source, symbol, day) in ai_reports/tapes/*/shadow.jsonl + rejects.jsonl (sources: momentum, trending, movers, anthropic, xai, agy, bb_live) plus sessions/*/sources.jsonl.gz and discord.jsonl.gz where present
T7_source_audit.entry: close of the nomination day (the desk could hold overnight at the close; no intraday look-ahead); also nomination price -> close as info
T7_source_audit.horizons: 1, 5, 10 trading days close-to-close, SIP daily bars
T7_source_audit.baseline: same-day equal-weight mean of U2 (random liquid names), excess = pick - baseline; day-clustered t
T7_source_audit.cost: not charged in the headline (spreads of nominated names are unmeasured); gross excess must beat ~20-30 bp to matter
T7_source_audit.note: descriptive audit: no split, no promotion; history 2026-08-04..2026-09-25 (~37 days)
